metadata.title: Mst. SUGRA BIBI vs MUHAMMAD AKBAR ALI

full_text:
2010 Y L R 12

[Lahore]

Before Sayed Zahid Hussain, C J

Mst. SUGRA BIBI---Applicant

Versus

MUHAMMAD AKBAR ALI---Respondent

T.A. No.190-C of 2008, decided on 30th June, 2008.

West Pakistan
Family Courts Act (XXXV of 1964)---

----S.5, Sched.
& S.25-A---Suit for maintenance, recovery of dowry articles and dissolution
of marriage---Transfer of suit---Application for---Applicant's suit was already
being tried by the Family Court at place 'J'; whereas suit for restitution of
conjugal rights was filed by respondent later on in the court at place
`K'---Applicant was not only the resident of place but the marriage also had
taken place at that place which assertions of the applicant remained
unrebutted---Taking said aspects into consideration, transfer of suit of
respondent from Family Court at place "J" where the Family Court was
already seized of the suit of the applicant, would serve the ends of
justice--Suit for restitution of conjugal rights, was ordered by the Family
Court to be transferred to the court at place 'J' where suit filed by the
applicant was pending---Both suits would be tried together by the Transferee
Court who would proceed expeditiously and decide the matter in accordance with
law after notice to respondent.

Mian Naseer Ahmad for Petitioner.

ORDER

SAYED ZAHID HUSSAIN, C.J.--Despite personal
service, the respondent has remained unrepresented.

Seeks transfer of suit titled "Muhammad Akbar
Ali v. Mst. Sugra Bibi" filed by the respondent for restitution of
conjugal rights which is being tried by the Family Court at Pattoki, District
Kasur.

The learned counsel contends that the petitioner's
suit for maintenance (for herself and children), for recovery of dowry articles
and for dissolution of marriage is already being tried by the Family Court,
Jahanian, District Khanewal whereas the suit for restitution of conjugal rights
was filed by the respondent later on, before Family Court, Pattoki District
Kasur. It is stated by the learned counsel that the petitioner is not only resident
of Jahanian but the marriage also had taken place at that place. All such
assertions have remained unrefuted. Taking these aspects into consideration,
the transfer of suit (filed by the respondent) from Family Court, Pattoki to
Family Court, Jahanian where the Family Court is already seized of the suit of
the petitioner, will serve the ends of justice. Let, therefore, the suit titled
"Muhammad Akbar Ali v. Mst. Sugra Bibi" for restitution of conjugal
rights be transmitted by the Judge Family Court, Pattoki to the Court of Mr.
Munsaf Khan Awan, Judge Family Court, Jahanian. Both the suits will be tried
together by the transferee Court who will proceed expeditiously and decide the
matter in accordance with law after notice to the respondent.

The petition is disposed of accordingly.

H.B.T./S-249/L Suit
transferred.
